title: EU AI Label Stamp Room
oneLiner: Marketing teams package AI-generated images, text, and public posts with the right disclosure label before the August 2026 transparency deadline.
targetUser: Small marketing agencies, content studios, and SaaS teams publishing AI-assisted public content into EU-facing channels.
keyUX: Drop content cards into a labeling room, classify AI use, choose disclosure wording, and export stamped asset instructions for each channel.
sourceSignalReferences: S11: EU AI Act transparency rules come into force in August 2026 - https://digital-strategy.ec.europa.eu/en/policies/regulatory-framework-ai
S1: Hada: ChatGPT Work expands app/file/browser agents - https://news.hada.io/topic?id=31281
twist: Focuses on production packaging for public content, not broad company AI policy.
smallGroupFit: A small content team can run it over next week’s posts before compliance gets formal.
spreadTrigger: The stamped checklist travels with designers, copywriters, and client approvers.
stitchPrompt: Create a responsive web app called "EU AI Label Stamp Room" for marketing teams preparing AI-generated images, text, and public posts for EU transparency rules. Include an asset intake wall, AI-use classifier, public-interest warning lane, disclosure wording picker, channel-specific label preview, approval history, and stamped asset checklist export. Design direction: use the premium-editorial profile with polished publishing surfaces, refined typography, elegant label stamps, and a high-trust campaign-review rhythm.
